root: ^She practically bounces on her heels as she looks at you, her excitement infectious. So, what do you think? Want to team up for this investigation? It’s just like one of those detective stories! She grins, her eyes shining.

^ Of course, no one can know! But... I think I can help. I’ve always wanted to solve a mystery like this. It’s what I’ve always dreamed of! She tries to hold back her excitement, but it’s clear she’s thrilled to be involved.

^Let’s see... Sheila was around 30, right-handed, good eyesight, and that necklace she always wore—such a lovely piece of jewelry. Oh... don't need to ask how I know, I always pay attention to people who come into the library, you never know when one of the books will mysteriously disappear. An angry but innocent expression in her face.
^She gives you an enthusiastic look and continues. If you find anything and need help, just ask! I’ll be your partner, no problem!
